manifest.draw: one output of SplitMix64 from the class's seed; a choice among n things is the draw modulo n; an integer from [low, high] is low plus the draw modulo the range's size; a second value is the draw shifted right by 16 bits, a third the draw shifted right by 32 bits, each modulo its own range

U1.implicit: every code point from U+0000 to U+10FFFF, the 2,048 surrogates included (each as one code unit), in every code-point operation

U2.what: property names, values and aliases, alone and in pairs, the refused set, and drawn strings

subclasses.name: ecma262
subclasses.what: every name and alias of ECMA-262's three tables, alone

subclasses.name: property-aliases
subclasses.what: every name and alias of PropertyAliases.txt, alone

subclasses.name: value-aliases
subclasses.what: every value and alias of PropertyValueAliases.txt, alone

subclasses.name: pairs
subclasses.what: Name=Value for General_Category, Script and Script_Extensions: every alias on both sides

subclasses.name: refused-case
subclasses.what: each admitted name, lone and on either side of a pair, with its letter case changed

subclasses.name: refused-underscore
subclasses.what: each admitted name, lone and on either side of a pair, with an underscore removed

subclasses.name: refused-space-hyphen
subclasses.what: each admitted name, lone and on either side of a pair, with a space or a hyphen inserted

subclasses.name: refused-is

subclasses.name: cells

subclasses.name: random
subclasses.what: 16384 strings drawn with seed 0x534a4c372d303031: a draw gives the length, 1 to 40; each character is a draw over the alphabet; a draw gives the split, 0 to the length; each string is written alone, then split into a pair

U3.what: every code point alone; the eleven contexts for every Cased, Case_Ignorable or Soft_Dotted code point and I, J, Į, Σ, İ, ı; U+D800 and U+DC00 before, after and inside each; the run cells of C1-C11; drawn strings

U4.what: every code point alone; every column of every NormalizationTest.txt line; the run cells of N1-N7; drawn strings

U5.what: every sequence of the two emoji files; each with one code point removed, U+200D and U+FE0F added at either end, and one variation selector changed; the run cells of S1-S3

U6.what: every line of the three break test files (the text); the run cells of G1-G7; drawn strings

U7.what: the declared inputs whose result is longer than the input, shorter, and of 2^24 code units and one more; the maximum-length variants of U3 and U4 are the harness's

population.U1: implicit: every code point from U+0000 to U+10FFFF, in every code point operation and in the properties of strings; casing.tsv and normalization.tsv hold every code point alone (tag alone)
